title: Bosnian uprising (1831–1833)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Bosnian uprising (1831–1833)", at revision 1381319777, opens: "The Bosnian uprising was a revolt of Bosnian Ayans against the Ottoman Sultan Mahmud II. The casus belli were reforms implemented by the Sultan to abolish the ayan system." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2586110, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1831–1833 revolt by Bosnian nobles against the Ottoman Empire". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
